post.description: OpenGraph/Twitter/oEmbed preview, cached 7 days. Failures answer 200 with just {url, finalUrl}.

get.description: Children of parentId (roots when omitted). Requires the X-Workspace-Id header.

post.description: multipart/form-data: file, nodeId (required), blockId?, propertyId?, purpose? (content|icon|cover). 413 when NOOK_MAX_UPLOAD_MB is exceeded.
Server-side fetch (SSRF-guarded: public http(s) hosts only, 10 s header timeout, upload size limit).

get.description: Bytes with Range support (206), ETag = sha256, Cache-Control: private, max-age=31536000. Inline unless ?download=1. SVG/HTML are served as application/octet-stream unless downloaded.

delete.description: Deletes the attachment row; the blob is removed by the daily blob-gc job once unreferenced for 24 h.

get.description: image/webp derivative; w ∈ {160, 320, 640, 1280, 1920} (default 640). 404 for non-images, 503 when libvips is unavailable.
